liftRotor.note: Spinner down, supports under the blade tips only. PETG or PLA+, 0.12 mm layers, 5 walls, 100% infill. Mirror image of the main fan: it turns the other way. Balance it before running.

liftRing.note: Flared lip on the bed. 2 walls. Press it into the fan bay from the top.

impeller.note: Spinner down, supports under the blade tips only. PETG or PLA+, 0.12 mm layers, 5 walls, 100% infill. Balance it before running.

duct.note: Rear flange on the bed, supports under the gearmotor plate only. The fan motor plate bridges 34 mm.

tailCone.note: Open end on the bed. Push fit; take it off to reach the motor screws.

seg1.note: Bearing-1 flange on the bed, supports on. Carries the joint-2 motor plate underneath.

seg2.note: Lay the upstream bearing face on the bed: rotate 50 degrees in the slicer. Supports on. Carries the joint-3 motor plate on top.

seg3.note: Exit on the bed, supports under the flange.

collarJ1.note: Flat, gear side down. Print 2 (bearing 1). 0.12 mm layers for clean teeth.

collar.note: Flat, gear side down. Print 2 (bearing 2). 0.12 mm layers for clean teeth.

collarJ3.note: Flat, gear side down. Print 2 (bearing 3): the lug is in a different place from bearing 2's.

pinion.note: Teeth up. Print 3 at 0.08 mm layers, 100% infill, or buy brass module-1 14-tooth pinions for a 3 mm D shaft.

washer.note: Not printed: cut 4 from 0.25 mm PTFE sheet (bearings 2 and 3), using the DXF or this file as a template. Silicone grease both sides.

washerJ1.note: Not printed: cut 2 from 0.25 mm PTFE sheet (bearing 1).
